executive_summary.headline: Preliminary review: flood mapping and industrial activity warrant follow-up
executive_summary.overview: Synthetic example: a mapped flood zone intersects the identified building footprint. The legal entity reports metalworking, but activity at the insured building and its fire protections are not verified.
executive_summary.key_takeaway: Verify the operating activity, fire-protection arrangements and replacement value before pricing.

construction.headline: Construction record available
construction.interpretation: The building record gives a construction year, but not enough verified structural information for a full assessment.

occupancy.headline: Metalworking disclosed at company level
occupancy.interpretation: Company-level metalworking is relevant to fire exposure but must not be attributed to this specific building without evidence.

protection.headline: Fire protections unverified
protection.interpretation: No verified sprinkler information is available; absence cannot be inferred.

exposure.headline: Mapped flood exposure
exposure.interpretation: A synthetic GIS layer intersects the identified footprint. Validate the specific peril, legend and map currency before underwriting use.

priority_findings.title: Potential site-level fire process uncertainty
priority_findings.observation: Metalworking is described at company level only.
priority_findings.underwriting_implication: Industrial thermal processes cannot be assumed present at the insured building.
priority_findings.recommended_action: Ask for a description of actual operations at the insured address.

priority_findings.title: Mapped flood exposure
priority_findings.observation: The synthetic GIS flood layer intersects the building footprint.
priority_findings.underwriting_implication: Review prevention and any special extensions; do not apply a location multiplier to the regulated natural-hazards tariff.
priority_findings.recommended_action: Review the published hazard layer and building vulnerability.

priority_findings.title: Reconstruction value missing
priority_findings.observation: No defensible replacement-cost value is supplied.
priority_findings.underwriting_implication: The building sum insured cannot be validated.
priority_findings.recommended_action: Obtain an approved valuation or sufficiently documented cost estimate.

hazard_interpretations.interpretation: Synthetic mapped flood exposure; verify the official layer and vulnerability separately.

valuation_commentary.reconstruction_value_comment: No defensible reconstruction value is available; do not display a CHF estimate.
valuation_commentary.market_value_comment: A market-price estimate is not needed for the initial building-only assessment.

visual_evidence.title: Synthetic mapped flood overlay
visual_evidence.caption: The building footprint intersects a synthetic flood polygon (illustration only).
visual_evidence.underwriting_relevance: Highlights why geospatial exposure should be reviewed without inferring insured flood damage.

open_questions.question: What is the validated reconstruction value of this building?
open_questions.reason_for_underwriter: Needed to confirm the insured sum and exposure.
open_questions.expected_answer_or_document: Current valuation report or documented rebuilding cost calculation.

open_questions.question: What industrial activities take place specifically at this address?
open_questions.reason_for_underwriter: Company-wide activity is not proof of the building occupancy or fire processes.
open_questions.expected_answer_or_document: Site occupancy statement or site-specific technical description.

open_questions.question: Are automatic sprinklers present and maintained?
open_questions.reason_for_underwriter: Protection measures can materially affect fire-loss severity and underwriting.

underwriter_next_step: Clarify building usage and protection; obtain a defensible reconstruction valuation, and validate the official flood layer before quotation.
